info.headline: Moderate Flood Warning for Bulloo River to Quilpie and Bulloo River at Quilpie
info.description:
Moderate flooding is occurring along the Bulloo River at Quilpie.
The Bulloo River at Quilpie is currently at 4.13 m and steady, with moderate flooding. The Bulloo River at Quilpie is likely to peak near 4.30 m overnight Sunday into Monday, with moderate flooding.
info.instruction:
* Don't drive, walk, swim or play in floodwater because it is dangerous. * Stay away from flooded drains, rivers, streams and waterways. * Obey road closure signs. Plan ahead so you don't drive on flooded roads. * Check the ABC and local media for updates. The situation can change quickly, so stay informed. * For local emergency management warnings and advice visit www.disaster.qld.gov.au/warnings.
For emergency assistance call SES on telephone number 132 500. In life-threatening emergencies, call 000 (triple zero) immediately.

info.headline: Minor Flood Warning for Bulloo River downstream of Quilpie and Bulloo River at Thargomindah
info.description:
River level rises are occurring along the Bulloo River downstream of Quilpie.
The Bulloo River at Thargomindah is currently at 3.69 m and steady, below the minor flood level. The Bulloo River at Thargomindah is likely to remain below the minor flood level for the next few days. Minor flooding is possible from late next week as upstream floodwaters arrive.
